mapper.select: SELECT employee_id,name,department,manager_id,annual_leave_days,used_leave_days FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT employee_id,name,department,manager_id,annual_leave_days,used_leave_days FROM employees WHERE employee_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT leave_id,employee_id,start_date,end_date,days,reason,status,created_at FROM employee_leave_requests WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} ORDER BY leave_id DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT leave_id,employee_id,start_date,end_date,days,reason,status,created_at FROM employee_leave_requests WHERE leave_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE employee_leave_requests SET status='CANCELLED' WHERE leave_id=#{id} AND status='APPROVED'
UPDATE employees SET used_leave_days=used_leave_days+#{days} WHERE employee_id=#{id} AND used_leave_days+#{days} BETWEEN 0 AND annual_leave_days
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM employee_leave_requests WHERE leave_id=#{id} AND status='CANCELLED'
